ops.statement: A reasoning gate skips crew implement/review specifically because the Commander already holds context -- but mechanical command-postconditions and driver scripts authored for that gate still need the SAME signature-verification and false-positive scrutiny a reviewer would apply. A postcondition authored at plan time (before the real files exist) can be wrong in ways that only show up when run for real; treat a reasoning gate's own checks as review-worthy, not exempt just because no crew was dispatched.
